summary: Phase B (Product Details Page + Wishlist + Resend email on return decision) fully verified. 9/9 backend pytest passed. All frontend flows work: product page, WhatsApp CTA, share menu, wishlist toggle (shop/product/account), account wishlist tab (move-to-cart + remove), low-stock badges, MRP strikethrough, hero view-details. Actual Resend emails delivered successfully via configured artyfex.in domain — backend logs confirm 'Email sent to' lines for both approve and reject.

Backend: DELETE /api/me/wishlist/{id} returns {action:'removed'} and item disappears from GET
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/returns/{id} approved returns 200 in <5s and logs 'Email sent to <email>: [ArtyFex] Return approved · ARF-...' (actual Resend delivery succeeded)
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/returns/{id} rejected also fires 'Email sent to ... Return rejected ...' log

Frontend Product Page /product/obsidian-geode-2x3: product-name='Obsidian Aurora', product-price='₹42,999', product-mrp='₹64,999' with line-through, savings badge 'Save ₹22,000 · 34% off', product-stock 'Only 3 left · Low stock', 4 variant swatches, qty +/- working
Frontend Product Page: product-whatsapp href contains wa.me/919970107760, encoded product name 'Obsidian%20Aurora', and product URL '/product/obsidian-geode-2x3'
Frontend Product Page: share menu opens with share-whatsapp, share-instagram, share-x, share-copy visible
Frontend Product Page (logged-out): wishlist click shows 'Sign in to save pieces' toast and opens Welcome Back auth dialog
Frontend Product Page (logged-in): wishlist button toggles from 'Save to wishlist' → 'Saved' with fill-gold heart, POST /me/wishlist fires
Frontend Shop Page: shop-card-link-obsidian-geode-2x3 links to /product/obsidian-geode-2x3, shop-wishlist-{slug} heart works, 'Only 3 left' badge shown, '% off' pill shown when mrp>price
Frontend Shop Page: wishlist click hits POST /api/me/wishlist/{id} and persists

Frontend Account Wishlist tab (account-tab-wishlist): items list rendered with move-to-cart and remove buttons; move-to-cart populates artyfex_cart_v1 localStorage; remove fires DELETE /me/wishlist/{id} and UI updates to 'Nothing saved yet'
Frontend Home / (ProductShowcase hero): hero-wishlist + hero-view-details buttons present, hero-view-details href='/product/obsidian-geode-2x3', 'Only 3 left' low-stock badge visible
action_items: No blockers. Phase B feature complete and verified end-to-end including live Resend delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountPage remove handler calls both toggleWish(p) (which already updates local state) AND refreshWish() — redundant network call. Minor perf nit only.

WishlistContext.toggle uses optimistic local-state update. If DELETE/POST fails silently the UI diverges from backend. Consider try/catch to rollback state on rejection (see catch{} in refresh which currently swallows errors silently).
ProductPage waHref includes the product URL derived from window.location.origin. On SSR this would break — fine for CRA but worth noting.
ShopPage.jsx handleWishlist calls e.preventDefault + stopPropagation which is correct since the heart button sits inside the Link. Good.
server.py send_email uses asyncio.to_thread + fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task — correct pattern. Error path logs but does not raise; verified endpoint returns in <5s.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@artyfex.in / ArtyFex@2026. Test users created dynamically via /api/auth/signup with TEST_wish_/TEST_fe_ prefix and cleaned up after backend suite.
seed_data_creation: Test users, orders, returns, and wishlist entries with TEST_wish_ email prefix cleaned up in teardown_module. Frontend test users (TEST_fe*) remain in DB but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B (Product Page + Wishlist + Resend email) fully verified. Backend regression: pytest backend/tests/test_wishlist_and_email.py + test_returns.py. Resend integration works with verified sender no-reply@artyfex.in — actual emails sent (visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). AuthContext stores raw JWT under localStorage key 'artyfex_user_token'; injecting this in FE tests bypasses UI login. WishlistContext exposes {has, toggle, items, refresh}. Frontend low-stock badge appears when stock>0 && stock<=3; Sold-out badge when stock<=0.
